scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && mkdir -p client/dist/terms client/dist/privacy && cp client/dist/index.html client/dist/terms/index.html && cp client/dist/index.html client/dist/privacy/index.html && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
